'''Izink''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he resided in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], where he reprogrammed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] to steal surveillance [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]].<ref name="TOR" />
